title: 第21章 康豪放下心结 青鱼讨价还价第22章 双魂领悟传送阵 收获颇丰
content_zh:
“郑风大哥，我有一个事情要告诉你，其实我就是剑门的免试外门弟子。”康昊的话引得郑风一愣神，半天不知从何说起。自己刚才还在和康昊调侃修为，没想到康昊已经是剑门的外门弟子，自己和景儿可还没有通过测试呢。
“不过正因为我成了剑门的外门弟子才招来了杀身之祸，因为大娘估计是怕我日后威胁她儿子康昭的地位，我一旦进了剑门以后就超出了她的掌控，为此才加害与我。还夺了我的“免试令牌”，想来很多事情你都通过巡逻队了解了。”康昊聪慧，知道郑风信息来源就是巡逻队员。
“不过我很庆幸这次能遇上郑风大哥的搭救，“免试令牌”可以三年内有效，留给康昭也没有什么，毕竟他是我血浓于水的兄弟。”
“其实我一直就不在意康庄少主的身份，让给小弟康昭也没有什么，只是觉得大娘心眼太小，看在因为她而认识了郑风大哥的份上，以后我就随族人喊他一声大夫人吧，从此我和他再无亲情上的瓜葛。”康昊一脸心痛，深思熟虑后做出了决定。
“好了，死过一回的人也不用扭捏了，男子汉拿得起放得下，外面的世界无比旷阔，为武道拼搏，那才是我康昊向往的生活。”康昊仿佛变了一个人，变得活跃起来。
“看来兄弟是真的将不愉快放下了，那我们直接和众人汇合，赶往剑门吧，从此开始全新的武道之路。”郑风鼓励康昊，也欣赏康昊的心胸，即便被大夫人如此迫害，对兄弟康昭还是没有丝毫记恨，顾念血浓于水的亲情，对大夫人的恶毒还能以族人待之。
“一会我带大伙去江枫城的渔村，抄一条近道可到明月城。”
“明月城有传送阵到剑门外的小风岗，那是剑门今年的招生之地。”
“这是最快到达剑门的方式。是去年的招生长老透露给我的路线。”康昊提供的这个信息对郑风一行人来说太重要了。
郑风心情不错，“看来邀请兄弟加入天团少年，是我睿智的决定！”
“那是自然！”郑风话未停，康昊就接上了，笑得自豪还有些小得意。
一行人汇合，按照康昊的路线，很快就来到了明月城。当众人看到明月城的传送阵时，大伙不禁惊呼起来。
“天啦，这么贵，每人五枚中品神晶，二十人以上每人四枚中品神晶。”郑杰和妙沁阳都吼的特别大声。
“一枚中品神晶可以买十张豪华船票，百张下等船票，二十人以上每人四枚中品神晶是不便宜，特别是不足二十人时，还要五枚就更贵了。”青鱼看了牌价，打算上前支付，十分肉疼，他总不能让古风动用前辈们的修炼神晶。本来郑风交到他手上的神晶就只有两百多枚，不到三百枚，这一下就要用掉三分之一，
"前辈，我们一行二十四人，能不能优惠一点，九十枚可好？“青鱼是本着能省则省，多问一句，说不好就省下几枚。
这也是青鱼这个太上助理感觉很难为情的事情，但当家就得这样。毕竟手里拮据，容不得浪费一丝一毫。丢自己面子是小，省下一些神晶，大伙日子都好过一点。
”看在你们大都是少年天才的份上，优惠一个人的，九十二枚，不能再少了。”窗口里坐着的中年大叔，看着青鱼一行人，一个比一个年少，看吼得凶的郑杰和妙沁阳，一个十三岁，一个十七岁，站在郑风身边的康昊只有十六岁，都是不错的苗子。
郑风不知道，中年大叔忽略了他，觉得郑杰十三岁把体格练得如此强壮，妙沁阳修行丹道少年有成，康昊也进入了他的法眼，其他就数景儿和沐沐了，只是中年大叔不知道景儿和郑风都有隐藏阵盘。为了预防别人对特殊血脉的感应，武道修为也隐藏了些。
“谢谢大哥，能得到你的体恤，很是感激！”青鱼喜出望外，一下省了四枚中品神晶，原本青鱼想来大叔能优惠一两枚就不错。
“呵呵，给你少了四枚神晶，就从前辈变成了大哥，不过我爱听，祝你们好运！”中年大叔原本没有表情的脸，也生动起来。

看着青鱼为几枚中品神晶讲价的时候，几位前辈很是赞赏，出门在外能省一下一枚神晶也是好的。
郑风没有表情，心里记下了，修炼物资交给青鱼是郑风早就想好的。青鱼的谋略、大局观都不错，现在看来又多了一条优点，为了团队的利益，放得下面子。
郑风的淡定，青鱼为团队议价，康昊都看在眼里，他本想去付神晶，但他没有想好如何处理郑风还给他的神晶。虽然在结识郑风以前，他或许不会讽刺嘲笑青鱼的这种小家子气，但绝不会欣赏。他发现郑风没有阻止青鱼作为少年难为情的讨价还价行为，却推脱了外婆的几千枚中品神晶。他还知道青鱼和古风的神晶都是郑风给的。他对郑风越了解，越欣赏，无形中对青鱼的讲价也认同了
只是他不知道郑风的想法。为了青鱼以后能大气官家，郑风发誓要多赚神晶。不让青鱼再像今日这般“难为情”。
如康昊所说，这条通道并非盈利通道，是剑门招生长老告知的，可说是剑门对外的连接传送站点之一，看到中年大叔打探他们天团少年时郑风自然知道了，人家本是明码标价，童叟无欺，大叔是看在未来学员的面子上没有较真。
剑门给郑风的第一印象还是不错的。
content_en:
"Brother Zheng Feng, I have something to tell you. In fact, I am an outer disciple of Jianmen who is exempted from the examination." Kang Hao's words made Zheng Feng stunned, and he didn't know where to start for a long time. Just now, I was teasing Kang Hao about his cultivation, but he didn't expect that Kang Hao was already an outer disciple of Jianmen, and he and Jing'er had not passed the test yet.
"But it was precisely because I became an outer disciple of Jianmen that I was killed. The aunt was probably afraid that I would threaten her son Kang Zhao's status in the future. Once I entered Jianmen, I would be out of her control, so she harmed me. She also took away my "exemption token." I think you know a lot of things through the patrol team." Kang Hao was smart and knew that the source of Zheng Feng's information was the patrol team.
"But I'm very lucky to be rescued by Brother Zheng Feng this time. The "exemption token" can be valid for three years, so there is nothing left for Kang Zhao. After all, he is my brother whose blood is thicker than water."
"Actually, I have never cared about Young Master Kangzhuang's identity. There is nothing wrong with giving it to my younger brother Kang Zhao. I just feel that my aunt is too small-minded. Since I got to know Brother Zheng Feng because of her, from now on I will follow the clan and call him Madam. From now on, I will have no family ties with him." Kang Hao looked heartbroken and made a decision after careful consideration.
"Well, people who have died once don't have to worry about it. A man can take it and let it go. The outside world is extremely vast. Fighting for martial arts is the life that I, Kang Hao, yearn for." Kang Hao seemed to have become a different person and became more active.
"It seems that the brothers have really put aside their unhappiness. Let's join the others directly and rush to Jianmen to start a new martial arts road from now on." Zheng Feng encouraged Kang Hao and admired Kang Hao's broad-mindedness. Even though he was so persecuted by the eldest lady, he still did not bear any grudge against his brother Kang Zhao. He cared about the family affection that was thicker than water and could still treat the eldest lady's viciousness as a clan member.
"I'll take everyone to the fishing village in Jiangfeng City later. We can take a shortcut to Mingyue City."
"There is a teleportation array in Mingyue City to Xiaofeng Gang outside Jianmen. That is where Jianmen recruits students this year."
"This is the fastest way to reach Jianmen. It was the route revealed to me by the admissions elder last year." This information provided by Kang Hao was too important to Zheng Feng and his party.
Zheng Feng was in a good mood, "It seems that inviting my brothers to join Tiantuan Youth is a wise decision on my part!"
"That's natural!" Before Zheng Feng stopped talking, Kang Hao took over, smiling proudly and a little proudly.
The group of people met together and soon arrived at Mingyue City following Kang Hao's route. When everyone saw the teleportation array in Mingyue City, everyone couldn't help but exclaimed.
"Oh my God, it's so expensive. Five middle-grade divine crystals per person, four mid-grade divine crystals per person for more than 20 people." Zheng Jie and Miao Qinyang both roared very loudly.
"One medium-grade divine crystal can buy ten luxury tickets, and a hundred lower-class tickets. Four medium-grade divine crystals per person for more than 20 people is not cheap, especially if there are less than 20 people, five more are even more expensive." Qingyu looked at the price and planned to go forward to pay. It was very painful. He could not let Gu Feng use the cultivation crystals of his predecessors. Originally, Zheng Feng gave him only more than 200 divine crystals, but less than 300. One third of them will be used now.
"Senior, there are twenty-four of us, can you give me a discount, maybe ninety coins?" Qingyu always saves money when he can. If he asks more questions, he will save a few coins if he can't.
This is something that Qing Yu, the Supreme Assistant, feels embarrassed about, but that's what a leader has to do. After all, money is tight and there is no room for waste. It's a shame to lose one's face. Save some divine crystals and everyone's life will be easier.
"Seeing that most of you are young geniuses, the discount for each person is ninety-two, no more." The middle-aged uncle sitting in the window looked at Qingyu and his group, each one younger than the other, and looked at Zheng Jie and Miao Qinyang, who were roaring fiercely, one was thirteen years old, and the other was seventeen years old, standing next to Zheng Jie.Kang Hao next to Feng is only sixteen years old, and they are both good prospects.
Zheng Feng didn't know that the middle-aged uncle ignored him, thinking that Zheng Jie had become so strong at the age of thirteen, Miao Qinyang was successful in practicing alchemy as a young man, Kang Hao also came into his Dharma Eyes, and the others were Jing'er and Mu Mu, but the middle-aged uncle didn't know that Jing'er and Zheng Feng both had hidden arrays. In order to prevent others from sensing the special bloodline, his martial arts cultivation was also hidden.
"Thank you, brother. I'm very grateful for your consideration!" Qingyu was overjoyed and saved four mid-grade divine crystals at once. Originally, Qingyu thought it would be nice if the uncle offered a discount of one or two.
"Haha, I have lost four divine crystals for you, and you have changed from a senior to a big brother. But I like to hear it. I wish you good luck!" The middle-aged uncle's originally expressionless face became vivid.
When watching Qingyu bargaining for several mid-grade divine crystals, several seniors were very impressed. It was good to save a divine crystal when going out.
Zheng Feng showed no expression and made a mental note that it was Zheng Feng's long thought to hand over the cultivation materials to Qingyu. Qingyu's strategy and overall view are good, and now it seems that he has another advantage. For the benefit of the team, he is willing to put his face down.
Kang Hao saw Zheng Feng's calmness and Qingyu negotiating the price for the team. He wanted to pay for the divine crystal, but he didn't figure out how to deal with the divine crystal that Zheng Feng returned to him. Although before getting to know Zheng Feng, he might not have ridiculed Qing Yu's petty attitude, but he would never appreciate it. He discovered that Zheng Feng did not stop Qingyu from his embarrassing bargaining behavior as a young man, but instead shied away from his grandmother's thousands of mid-grade divine crystals. He also knew that the divine crystals of Qingyu and Gufeng were given by Zheng Feng. The more he gets to know Zheng Feng, the more he appreciates it, and he also subconsciously agrees with herring's bargaining.
It's just that he doesn't know what Zheng Feng is thinking. In order for Qingyu to be popular among officials in the future, Zheng Feng vowed to earn more divine crystals. Don't let Qingyu be as "embarrassed" as today.
As Kang Hao said, this passage is not a profit passage. It was informed by the recruitment elder of Jianmen. It can be said to be one of Jianmen's external connection transmission sites. Zheng Feng naturally knew it when he saw the middle-aged uncle asking about their Tiantuan youth. The price was clearly marked, and the uncle did not take it seriously because of the face of the future students.
The first impression Jianmen gave Zheng Feng was good.
